name: M/Y Lady Lene
lede: On a custom 34-metre explorer yacht from Van der Valk, white Platinum Electric Marine heaters are recessed into the deck heads of the VIP balcony and the aft entertainment deck, so the owner and guests use them all year.
data: Aft deck entertainment area and VIP balcony

hero.caption: Heaters recessed flush in the curved aft deck ceiling. Bromic-published photograph from the case study.

photos.caption: Platinum Electric Marine over the aft lounge at sunset. Bromic-published photograph from the case study.

beats: The aft entertainment area is the yacht’s design focus, with zones to relax and dine, a bar and a swim platform. Built by Van der Valk, she was designed by a team including Diana Yacht Design and Ginton Naval Architects.
The owner and guests wanted the aft decks comfortable and usable year-round, with heating that suited the yacht’s clean, elegant design.
White Platinum Smart-Heat Electric Marine heaters, in AISI316 stainless steel, were recessed into the bridge deck aft VIP balcony and the aft deck entertainment area.
